item.title: Google’s AI Overviews Can Scam You. Here’s How to Stay Safe
item.description: Beyond mistakes or nonsense, deliberately bad information being injected into AI search summaries is leading people down potentially harmful paths.

item.title: OpenAI Is Nuking Its 4o Model. China’s ChatGPT Fans Aren’t OK
item.description: As OpenAI removed access to GPT-4o in its app on Friday, people who have come to rely on the chatbot for companionship are mourning the loss all over the world.

item.title: Zillow Has Gone Wild—for AI
item.description: As the housing market stalls, Zillow’s CEO sees AI as “an ingredient rather than a threat” that can both help the company protect its turf and reinvent how people search for homes.

item.title: Inside the New York City Date Night for AI Lovers
item.description: EVA AI created a pop-up romantic date night at a Manhattan wine bar to help making AI-human relationships a “new normal.”

item.title: ‘Uncanny Valley’: ICE’s Secret Expansion Plans, Palantir Workers’ Ethical Concerns, and AI Assistants
item.description: In this episode of Uncanny Valley, our hosts dive into WIRED’s scoop about a secret Trump administration campaign extending right into your backyard.

item.title: A Wave of Unexplained Bot Traffic Is Sweeping the Web
item.description: From small publishers to US federal agencies, websites are reporting unusual spikes in automated traffic linked to IP addresses in Lanzhou, China.

item.title: OpenAI’s President Gave Millions to Trump. He Says It’s for Humanity
item.description: In an interview with WIRED, Greg Brockman says his political donations support OpenAI's mission—even if some employees at the company disagree.

item.title: Crypto-Funded Human Trafficking Is Exploding
item.description: The use of cryptocurrency in sales of human beings for prostitution and scam compounds nearly doubled in 2025, according to a conservative estimate. Many of the deals are happening in plain sight.

item.title: I Tried RentAHuman, Where AI Agents Hired Me to Hype Their AI Startups
item.description: Rather than offering a revolutionary new approach to gig work, RentAHuman is filled with bots that just want me to be another cog in the AI hype machine.

item.title: I Loved My OpenClaw AI Agent—Until It Turned on Me
item.description: I used the viral AI helper to order groceries, sort emails, and negotiate deals. Then it decided to scam me.
